Ride Action reference artwork

The seven WebP files are original product photographs from the official Ride Action catalog. Product URLs and per-image rectification coordinates are listed in `dist/ride-action.js`. The application rectifies each photographed sheet on a canvas and maps the artwork onto the concave deck. Artwork belongs to its respective rights holders; this project does not claim ownership or affiliation.

Catalog: https://rideaction.ru/catalog/detali/shkurki/brand-ride-action/
Storm grips: https://rideaction.ru/catalog/detali/gripsy/gripsy-ride-action-storm-chernye/

Listed grip-tape weight is the uncut sheet weight (80 g, 620 × 170 mm). Grips are 100 g per pair, 165 mm. Prices in the configurator are estimates.
